title: Prone
metaphor: A full earth-brown human body lying FACE DOWN horizontally along a short ivory floor line, arms bent out beside the head, legs straight. Entire figure low and flat; visibly on the ground, not a portrait or sleeping face.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint exactly ONE original Turnip Works tabletop condition pictogram for prone: A full earth-brown human body lying FACE DOWN horizontally along a short ivory floor line, arms bent out beside the head, legs straight. Entire figure low and flat; visibly on the ground, not a portrait or sleeping face. Dominant subject colour key: earth brown; keep this colour strongly visible, not just a tiny accent. Heroic hand-painted style D, chunky matte painted forms, broad soft bevels, restrained brushwork. Center on a pale warm parchment circular ground with a quiet thin antique brass rim; use dark outlines for strong contrast. Upper-left light. Straight-on circular badge; outer circle fills 94 percent of square canvas, pictogram fills 80 percent of disc. Readable at31px and smaller: bold silhouette, thick features, generous negative space, absolutely no tiny detail. Native transparent alpha outside the circle. No text, lettering, numbers, watermark, decorative flourishes or extra scene. Our own text-only design, no trademarked game iconography and no third-party references.
blind_prompt: This is an original small status icon for a tabletop pawn. View it at its supplied 31-pixel size. Which D&D condition does this icon show? First describe its visible silhouette and colours, then name your single best condition and confidence. If it instead depicts clearing conditions, say so. Do not infer anything from its filename. Be concise.
